MonsterAI.m_onConsumedItem: Action triggered when the monster successfully consumes an item.
MonsterAI.m_alertRange: The distance at which the monster becomes alerted to threats.
MonsterAI.m_fleeIfHurtWhenTargetCantBeRe: Whether the monster flees if damaged and its target is unreachable.
MonsterAI.m_fleeUnreachableSinceAttackin: Time after which the creature flees if its target remains unreachable while attacking.
MonsterAI.m_fleeUnreachableSinceHurt: Time after which the creature flees if its target remains unreachable after being hurt.
MonsterAI.m_fleeIfNotAlerted: Whether the creature flees from danger when it is not currently alerted.
MonsterAI.m_fleeIfLowHealth: Health percentage threshold below which the creature will start fleeing.
MonsterAI.m_fleeTimeSinceHurt: How long the creature continues fleeing after being hurt.
MonsterAI.m_fleeInLava: Whether the creature flees when it enters lava.
MonsterAI.m_fleePheromoneMin: Minimum value for the pheromone system used during fleeing behavior (?)
MonsterAI.m_fleePheromoneMax: Maximum value for the pheromone system used during fleeing behavior (?)
MonsterAI.m_circulateWhileCharging: Whether the creature circles around its target while preparing an attack.
MonsterAI.m_circulateWhileChargingFlying: Whether the flying creature circles its target while preparing an attack.
MonsterAI.m_enableHuntPlayer: If true, the creature will actively hunt and track players down.
MonsterAI.m_attackPlayerObjects: Whether the creature will attack player-built structures and objects.
MonsterAI.m_privateAreaTriggerTreshold: Number of private area triggers before the monster becomes hostile (?)
MonsterAI.m_interceptTimeMax: Maximum time the creature spends trying to intercept its moving target.
MonsterAI.m_interceptTimeMin: Minimum time the creature spends trying to intercept its moving target.
MonsterAI.m_maxChaseDistance: Maximum distance the creature will chase a target before giving up.
MonsterAI.m_minAttackInterval: Minimum time the creature must wait between consecutive attacks.
MonsterAI.m_circleTargetInterval: Time interval between decisions to circle around the target.
MonsterAI.m_circleTargetDuration: How long the creature circles its target before attacking or moving.
MonsterAI.m_circleTargetDistance: The distance the creature maintains while circling its target.
MonsterAI.m_sleeping: Whether the creature spawns in a sleeping state.
MonsterAI.m_wakeupRange: The range at which the creature wakes up from sleep due to players.
MonsterAI.m_noiseWakeup: Whether nearby noises can wake the creature from sleep.
MonsterAI.m_maxNoiseWakeupRange: Maximum range at which noise can wake up the sleeping creature.
MonsterAI.m_wakeupEffects: Visual and audio effects played when the creature wakes up.
MonsterAI.m_sleepEffects: Visual and audio effects played while the creature is sleeping.
MonsterAI.m_wakeUpDelayMin: Minimum delay in seconds before the creature fully wakes up.
MonsterAI.m_wakeUpDelayMax: Maximum delay in seconds before the creature fully wakes up.
MonsterAI.m_fallAsleepDistance: Distance from players at which the creature can fall asleep.
MonsterAI.m_avoidLand: Whether the creature actively avoids moving onto land.
MonsterAI.m_consumeItems: List of items that the creature is able to eat.
MonsterAI.m_consumeRange: Distance from an item at which the creature can eat it.
MonsterAI.m_consumeSearchRange: Distance within which the creature will search for food to eat.
MonsterAI.m_consumeSearchInterval: How often the creature searches for nearby food items.
BaseAI.m_onBecameAggravated: Action triggered when a passive-aggressive creature becomes hostile.
BaseAI.m_viewRange: The maximum distance the creature can see targets.
BaseAI.m_viewAngle: The field of view angle for the creature's vision.
BaseAI.m_hearRange: The maximum distance at which the creature can hear noises.
BaseAI.m_mistVision: Whether the creature can see through mist or fog unaffected.
BaseAI.m_alertedEffects: Visual and audio effects played when the creature becomes alerted.
BaseAI.m_idleSound: Sound effects played periodically while the creature is idle.
BaseAI.m_idleSoundInterval: Time interval between periodic idle sound plays.
BaseAI.m_idleSoundChance: The percentage chance for an idle sound to play each interval.
BaseAI.m_pathAgentType: The pathfinding agent type, determining how it navigates the world.
BaseAI.m_moveMinAngle: Minimum angle to target required before the creature starts moving forward.
BaseAI.m_smoothMovement: Whether the creature's movement pathing and turning are smoothed out.
BaseAI.m_serpentMovement: Enables swimming snake-like movement physics and animations.
BaseAI.m_serpentTurnRadius: The turning radius limit for serpent-like swimming movement.
BaseAI.m_jumpInterval: Cooldown interval between random jumps during movement.
BaseAI.m_randomCircleInterval: How often the creature chooses a new random direction to circle.
BaseAI.m_randomMoveInterval: How often the creature chooses a new random point to idle-walk.
BaseAI.m_randomMoveRange: The maximum distance the creature will wander during random idle movement.
BaseAI.m_randomFly: Whether the creature wanders randomly through the air.
BaseAI.m_chanceToTakeoff: The periodic chance for a flying creature on the ground to takeoff.
BaseAI.m_chanceToLand: The periodic chance for a flying creature to land on the ground.
BaseAI.m_groundDuration: Average time a flying creature spends on the ground before taking off.
BaseAI.m_airDuration: Average time a flying creature spends in the air before landing.
BaseAI.m_maxLandAltitude: Maximum altitude at which a flying creature is allowed to land.
BaseAI.m_takeoffTime: How long the takeoff sequence takes before the creature is considered airborne. (?)
BaseAI.m_flyAltitudeMin: Minimum altitude relative to the ground the creature maintains while flying.
BaseAI.m_flyAltitudeMax: Maximum altitude relative to the ground the creature maintains while flying.
BaseAI.m_flyAbsMinAltitude: The absolute minimum altitude above sea level the creature must maintain. (?)
BaseAI.m_avoidFire: Whether the creature pathfinds around fires to avoid taking damage.
BaseAI.m_afraidOfFire: Whether the creature actively flees when near any fire source.
BaseAI.m_avoidWater: Whether the creature avoids pathfinding through deep water.
BaseAI.m_avoidLava: Whether the creature actively avoids stepping into lava.
BaseAI.m_skipLavaTargets: Whether the creature ignores targets that are standing inside lava.
BaseAI.m_avoidLavaFlee: Whether the creature avoids pathfinding through lava when fleeing.
BaseAI.m_aggravatable: Whether a passive creature can be angered by attacking it.
BaseAI.m_passiveAggresive: Whether the creature only attacks players who attack them first.
BaseAI.m_spawnMessage: The shout or screen message displayed when this creature spawns.
BaseAI.m_deathMessage: The shout or screen message displayed when this creature dies.
BaseAI.m_alertedMessage: The shout or screen message displayed when this creature becomes alerted.
BaseAI.m_fleeRange: The distance the creature tries to maintain from threats when fleeing.
BaseAI.m_fleeAngle: The angle relative to the threat used to calculate fleeing paths.
BaseAI.m_fleeInterval: How often the creature recalculates its fleeing path away from threats.
